verdict.rationale: Community reports say the underlying containers shut down automatically after receiving no requests and move to an idle state (comm-5, comm-4). First-party docs show only a per-session default command timeout (docs-19), not a sandbox-lifecycle timeout. Another user found no way to auto-destroy a sandbox after a set idle period and had to build their own cleanup (comm-7). That supports a partial verdict, not a dispute, since no vendor claim of configurable idle destruction exists in the pack. Missing for 10: a documented, configurable sandbox-level idle or max-lifetime timeout, first-party confirmation that billing stops when idle, auto-destroy on completion, and hands-on corroboration.
